item_summary: $250-300 ergonomic mid-back mesh office chair with adjustable lumbar support and 3D armrests
detailed_item_draft: Seeking a mid-range ergonomic task chair specifically priced between $250 and $300 USD. Primary construction must feature a breathable mesh backrest extending to mid-back height for proper spinal support without restricting movement. The chair requires a dynamic adjustable lumbar support mechanism allowing both height and depth customization to match user curvature. Armrests must be fully 3D adjustable, enabling height, pivot angle, and forward/backward depth modification. Seat cushion should utilize high-resilience foam with a waterfall edge design to reduce leg pressure. Base must be a durable 5-star nylon or reinforced aluminum configuration with smooth-rolling dual-wheel casters suitable for hard floors or carpet. Certification should meet or exceed BIFMA standards for stability and durability, supporting a maximum user weight capacity of at least 250 lbs. Warranty coverage should include a minimum of 5 years on mechanical components and gas lift cylinder. Preferably offered with minimal-tool assembly instructions and a trial period for comfort evaluation.
